personal_info.name: Vadym Alyekseyenko
personal_info.title: AI & Automation Engineer · Digital Transformation Lead
personal_info.tagline: I build and run production AI and automation systems for a four-brand group, partnering with owners on strategy and delivery.

summary: Digital transformation and AI automation lead for HABITARMOS / ESTORESRAINHA GROUP (four brands): built HABITAI cockpit unifying ERP, CRM, logistics, inventory AI, marketing ops, and field apps. Architected PHC cloud read-replica (5M+ rows, dbt marts, Metabase BI for leadership) and 80+ production workflows (~22.5k n8n runs/7d; n8n, Zoho Flow, Make.com). Innovation Hub: 55 projects, ~465h/month saved.

bullets: Architected a production PHC ERP cloud read replica (5M+ rows, ~8.9 GB PostgreSQL, 24+22 tables, 15-min sync, 99.1% reliability) with dbt marts, Metabase executive dashboards (Docker, SSH tunnel to VPS), and MCP metric tools so leadership and CRM use governed data, not LAN SQL.
Built HABITAI operations cockpit across 4 brands: MCP agent orchestration, multimodal RAG (Docling, ColPali, Qdrant), predictive inventory, Distribution 360, and executive KPI dashboards.
Scaled 80+ production workflows (n8n, Zoho Flow, Make.com) to ~22.5k n8n runs/7d and ~4k Zoho Flow runs/month for ERP-CRM ingestion, alerts, and Discord observability.
Coached ~40 staff and led UX/UI, graphic design, and 2 junior developers while translating ERP and CRM data into KPIs for owners and a 500+ distributor network.

experience.role: Senior AI Systems and Automation Engineer
bullets: Built ZohoSync PHC SQL Server to Zoho Bigin (EU) for 500+ distributors: 893 accounts, 2,405 contacts, and ~2k pipeline records so reps track targets, gap-to-goal, and stalled deals.

Led ESTORESRAINHA digital turnaround for 15k+ customers (~11.4k mapped from the cloud replica into Twenty CRM): replaced paper workflows with automated scheduling, catalog, service tracking, and agent-assisted CRM ingestion.

Delivered app-tecnicos (services-blinds PWA) in production on Hetzner for 40 daily users across technicians, warehouse, dispatch, and office: Next.js 16, offline-first Dexie queue, Google Maps routing, GraphQL Twenty CRM sync, transactional outbox, and GCP Speech-to-Text visit summaries.

Engineered orcamentos-ia quoting platform (FastAPI + React): 124k+ deterministic pricing tiers across 20+ supplier price-list plug-ins with Docling/Celery PDF ingestion, cutting multi-brand quote generation from days to minutes with zero price hallucination.

Built the group's web footprint from zero across 4 brands: corporate sites habitarmos.com & estoresrainha.com (WordPress) and catalog properties arkitek.pt & skuba.com.pt (WordPress) · scaling ARKITEK/SKUBA to 15k+ combined monthly visits through technical SEO and catalog storytelling.
Automated product visual generation with custom Stable Diffusion SDXL LoRAs via ComfyUI and built multimodal computer-vision pipelines for SKU matching and catalog synchronization.

experience.role: Freelance B2B Automation & Digital Services Consultant
bullets: Run ALYGEN, the trading name for my freelance B2B services (web, automation, and digital operations for SMBs): closed €20k+ in client work after prospecting 6,000+ companies with automated audits.

Built Alygen CRM, my own sales tool (https://github.com/alyekseyenko/alygen), scaling outreach from ~4 to ~200 leads/day with sub-3-minute proposals via Chromium audits, ML lead scoring, and multi-agent Email, WhatsApp, and Telegram dispatch (React, Node.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL/pgvector).

Long-term client Rute Carreira (coaching & wellness): built rutecarreira.com, asuaessencia.com, and oseuplanob.com from zero, grew oseuplanob.com leads from ~2/week to ~5 · 10/day, and have run the e-commerce and luxury event ticketing in production for 3+ years.

projects.title: HABITAI · Unified Operations Platform
projects.problem: Operations data lived in ERP, CRM, logistics, and spreadsheets with no single place for owners or field teams to act.
projects.built: Operations cockpit tying PHC data, CRM sync, automation, inventory signals, and agent-assisted Q&A on governed metrics.
impact: Single source of truth across warehouses, distributors, finance, and field ops
ZohoSync + commercial dashboards: 500+ distributors, objectives vs invoicing
MCP + 80+ production workflows (~22.5k n8n runs in a recent 7-day sample)

projects.title: PHC ERP · Cloud Read Replica
projects.problem: CRM and automations could not safely use live ERP data without exposing on-prem SQL or copying numbers by hand.
projects.built: Hybrid sync to PostgreSQL on a VPS, dbt marts, role-scoped access, and executive dashboards for two PHC tenants.
impact: Two companies on one governed Postgres platform on the VPS (habitarmos_* / estores_* schemas).
5M+ replicated rows (Oct 2026, ~5.4M measured): ~8.9 GB Postgres; HabitArmos ~3.01M (24 tables) and Estores ~2.35M (22 tables), wave 4 on both tenants.

projects.title: app-tecnicos · Field Operations PWA
projects.problem: Field service ran on paper: slow customer updates, lost technician time, and no shared schedule when clients called.
projects.built: Production PWA with offline queue, maps and routing, warehouse module, and Twenty CRM sync on Hetzner.
impact: In production (not a pilot): 40 people use the app across field, warehouse, dispatch, and office
Single operational picture: who is scheduled, where technicians are, visit status, and product/service state when customers call
Offline-first PWA so field work continues without mobile signal; measurements and job data replay safely to CRM

projects.title: orcamentos-ia · Multi-Supplier Quoting
projects.problem: Quotes depended on manual PDF and spreadsheet work; sales waited days while prices had to stay auditable.
projects.built: FastAPI and React platform with supplier plug-ins, deterministic pricing tiers, PDF ingestion, and CRM handoff.
impact: Quote cycles collapsed from days to minutes with auditable unit prices frozen at proposal time
20+ supplier catalogs ingested via PDF/Excel pipeline with human review and versioned price lists
AI assistant composes budgets using DB lookups only · margins, VAT, installation lines recalc live

projects.title: Alygen CRM · B2B Outreach Stack
projects.problem: Freelance prospecting meant hours of manual site audits and slow, generic proposals per lead.
projects.built: Open-source CRM with automated technical audits, ML lead scoring, agent-assisted copy, and email and messaging dispatch.
impact: Outreach scale: ~4 → ~200 leads/day; €12k pipeline closed in first 7 days after automation
Proposal turnaround under 3 minutes with localized PT-PT copy
65+ automated tests, local-first resilience (Postgres ↔ SQLite failover)

projects.title: Container Risk Radar · Fleet Observability
projects.problem: Websites, VPS hosts, containers, and automations were monitored in separate tools with no shared risk picture.
projects.built: Docker Compose observability stack with Prometheus, Loki, Grafana, scoring engine, and a Next.js control dashboard.
impact: One fixed control surface for websites, cloud, containers, automations, hosting, and quotas · instead of context-switching across disconnected UIs
Explainable per-container risk_score (0.0 · 1.0) to prioritize issues before they cause customer or revenue impact
Slack and Telegram notifications keep a live operational picture regardless of location
